decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app is close to the firm's dental practice software, is presented as a flagship product line, and benefits from the firm's in-house R&D, so management can interpret early results and improve it.

The continuing education institute builds on the firm's existing training content and practitioner relationships, so the firm can assimilate feedback, though it lies further from core software engineering than the other products.
The remote screen sharing tool extends the firm's established customer support and integration capabilities, which makes it easy to learn from and refine with its own development knowledge.
